They nod heads and shoulders on a steady beat while their free gloved hands chop down in time. Snow streaks through the headlight beams. The parked sedans stay exactly where they are, nobody else appears, masks unchanged. SFX: howling wind, boots crunching on snow, idling engines. No voices.
